name: @holoscript/marketplace-agentkit
description: Fail-closed Coinbase CDP wallet integration for HoloScript marketplace agents

scripts.check: pnpm run test && pnpm run build

author: HoloScript Team

publicConsumption.coreRule: Live wallet and payment behavior fails closed; simulation requires explicit caller opt-in.
publicConsumption.localAdapterBoundary: Credentials and custody policy are caller-owned inputs and are never package defaults.

holorepo.authBoundary: Reads Coinbase CDP credentials from explicit options or standard CDP environment variables; never emits secret values.
